reason: It sounds sensible, but my money has sat in NRO for years and I keep saying I'll sort it on the next trip. I'd bookmark this and watch another YouTube video on the rules, not start a transfer this month.
objection: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in, and I don't believe a third party fixes that. If the branch stalls the paperwork, I've paid a fee and still have to fly over.
would_change_my_mind: A named customer or a video from someone on the NRI finance channels I follow who moved a property-sale lump sum with my same bank and never set foot in a branch or took a call from the bank.
